titleEnglish: Dil Jis Se Zinda Hai — Traditional / Nusrat Fateh Ali Khan

verses.ar:
Dil jis se zinda hai wo tamanna tumhi to ho
Hum jis mein bas rahay hein wo dunya tumhi to ho
verses.en:
The longing that keeps the heart alive — that is only you
The world in which we dwell — that is only you

verses.ar: Dil jis se zinda hai wo tum ho
verses.en: The one from whom the heart draws life — that is you

verses.ar:
Teri zulf gar shab-e-qadr hai
Tera chehra badr-e-muneer hai
Tere sadqe jaaon mein ya-nabi
Tu habib-e-rabb-e-qadeer hai
verses.en:
If your tresses are the Night of Power
Your face is the full illuminated moon
I sacrifice myself for you, O Prophet
You are the Beloved of the All-Powerful Lord

verses.ar:
Tera husn jalwa e toor hai
Teri chakal surah e noor hai
Ke jahaan mein koi aaj tak
Teri misl hai na nazeer hai
verses.en:
Your beauty is the radiance of Mount Toor
Your radiance is the Surah of Light
For in all the world until today
There is no equal to you, no comparison

verses.ar:
Teri deed jisko naseeb hai
Wo naseeb qabil-e-deed hai
Tera dekhna meri eid hai
Tera rukh kalam-e-majeed hai
verses.en:
Whoever is blessed to behold you
That fortune itself is worth beholding
To see you is my Eid
Your face is the Glorious Word of God

verses.ar:
Teri deed karne ko khud khuda
Tujhe paas apne bula liya
To bitha ke saamne yeh kaha
Meri aaj arsh pe eid hai
verses.en:
To behold you, God Himself
Called you close to Him
And seating you before Him said
Today on My Throne is Eid

verses.ar:
Tera noor noor-e-qadeem hai
Tera husn husn-e-kamaal hai
Nahi jiski koi misaal hai
Tu he aamina ka wo laal hai
verses.en:
Your light is the eternal pre-existent light
Your beauty is beauty at its most perfect
Of which there is no comparison anywhere
You are that beloved son of Aminah

verses.ar:
Shahsawara raazdaraa Hoo
Taajdaara dardmanda sub diyaa
Ay alam nashra de seene waliya
Ay shahenshah madina waliya
Aavi ja wal fajr chehre waliya
Aavi ja yasin sehre waliya
Yaad teri da mei deeva waliya
Aavi ja hun kaali kamli waliya
verses.en:
O king of horsemen, keeper of secrets
O crowned one who gave everything to the sorrowful
O you who expanded the chest — come, O master
O King of Madina — come
Come, O one whose face is like the dawn
Come, O one whose turban is Yasin
I am a lamp in your remembrance, O master
Come now, O master of the black shawl
O my Beloved — welcome, welcome, welcome

verses.ar:
Roya shab e hijraan mein bohot ashq bahaya
Itni mein musawwir ko rehm jo aaya
Naqshe kayi tasveero ke wo saamnay laaya
Bola ke yeh yusuf hai yeh eesa hai yeh musa
Mein ne kaha in mein se kisi per nahi sheda
Jab saamnay laya wo shabeeh e shah e wala
Besaakhta us waqt zubaan se meri nikla
verses.en:
I wept much in the nights of separation, shedding many tears
When at last the Painter took pity on me
He brought forward many portraits he had painted
Saying: this is Yusuf, this is Isa, this is Musa
I said: I have no devotion for any of these
Then he brought forward the likeness of the noble Shah
And unbidden these words left my lips

verses.ar:
Mujh chand bashar shasaniye
Matthe chamke laath nooraniye
Kali zulf te akh mastaniye
Teri surat nu mein jaan akha
Jaana ke jaane jahan akha
Sach aakha te rub di shaan akha
Jis shaan to shana sub banya
Subhanallah, ma ajmalaka
Ma ahsanaka, ma akmalaka
Kithe mehr ali kithe teri sana
Gustaakh akhi kithe ja ariyan
verses.en:
O moon-like, radiant, kingly one
Your forehead shines with divine light
Your dark tresses and intoxicating eyes
I call your face my very life
I call it the life of the world
I spoke truth and spoke of God's own glory
From whose glory all glories are born
Subhanallah — How beautiful You are
How excellent, how perfect
Where is poor Mehr Ali to utter your praises
O where have these bold eyes alighted

verses.ar:
Jine dekhiya kamli waliya nu
Noohu nikliya wah subhanallah
Noori mukhre te kayi chamk diye
Kaise zulf e siyaah subhanallah
Tere husn di ki tareef karaan
Kahay uthiya khuda subhanallah
verses.en:
Whoever has beheld the master of the black shawl
Light emanates from him — SubhanAllah
How many radiances shine from that luminous face
And those dark tresses — SubhanAllah
How shall I praise your beauty
God Himself proclaimed — SubhanAllah

verses.ar:
Farishta dar pe basad ehtiraam aata hai
Khuda ke baad tumhara he naam aata hai
Kaleem hoon ge tumhein kya kaleem se nisbat
Tumhara ghar mein khuda ka kalaam aata hai
verses.en:
Angels come to your door with the utmost reverence
After God's name — it is your name that comes
What comparison can there be with Kaleem (Musa)?
Into your very home came the Word of God

verses.ar:
Tu ne qabl az do jahaan shan e tajalla dekhi
Arsh banta howa sajti howi dunya dekhi
Tere qadmo mein jhuki saray rasoolon ki jabeen
Sub ne allah ko mana teri dekha dekhi
verses.en:
Before both worlds you witnessed the glory of divine manifestation
You saw the Throne being built and the world being adorned
At your feet bowed the foreheads of all the Prophets
All affirmed God — following your lead

verses.ar:
Her ik kundal kundal uthe aashiq ta dil dolay
Husn tere di sift di aakha kaafir kalma bolay
verses.en:
On every lock of your hair the lover's heart sways
In praise of your beauty even the disbeliever utters the Kalima

verses.ar:
Ya noor ul ainee marhaba
Jaddil hussaini marhaba
Ya imam ul qiblatain
Ya nabi ul harmein
Aap hein aankhon ki thandak
Aap hein her dil ka chein
verses.en:
O light of my eyes — welcome
O grandfather of Hussain — welcome
O Imam of the two Qiblas
O Prophet of the two Harams
You are the coolness of all eyes
You are the peace of every heart

verses.ar:
Innaka shams ud duha
Innaka badr ud doja
Innaka noor ul huda
Innaka sadr ul ula
verses.en:
Verily you are the sun of the morning
Verily you are the full moon of the night
Verily you are the light of guidance
Verily you are the foremost of the highest
